subject: FOUNDATIONS OF COMPUTING: FROM HARDWARE ESSENTIALS TO WEB DESIGN

details.name: FOUNDATIONS OF COMPUTING: FROM HARDWARE ESSENTIALS TO WEB DESIGN

topics: Memory - Memory hierarchy: registers, cache, RAM, virtual memory
Storage devices- HDDs, SSDs, optical drives
Interface cards – Buses – Firmware - Boot process
Binary representation of data and numbers
Data storage units - bits, bytes, kilobytes, etc.
CPU Architecture and Instruction Set: Basic CPU architecture - ALU, registers, control unit
Instruction format and assembly language (basics only)
Shell scripting (bash). Computer Communications – LAN, MAN, WAN
Basics of IP addresses, DHCP, NAT
Web Design (Basics of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) – Understanding the web content delivery

partA.description:
2 Questions from each module.
Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description:
Each question carries 9 marks.
Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.
Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Identify the fundamental components and the working of an IT environment.
Explain the data representations, CPU architectures, and the basic functioning of a computer.
Explain the operating systems, computer network architecture, and necessary protocols used.
Develop simple interactive web pages and validate the inputs.
